releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.9
releases.body:
* Fixed player not being able to exit map after entering the ship
* Removed no longer needed `AstroObject` component from the prefab
releases.bodyZh:
* プレイヤーが船に入った後、地図から退出できないのを修正
* 不要になった`AstroObject`コンポーネントをプレハブから削除

releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.8
releases.body: * Adds Compatibility with owo using new shipyard networking interface system
releases.bodyZh: * Outer Wilds用の新しい船台ネットワーキングインターフェースシステムを使用した互換性を追加します

releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.7
releases.body:
* Using new Shipyard prefab system (need to use version v.0.1.8 or higher)
* Fixed wrong particle sync
releases.bodyZh:
* 新しいShipyardプレハブシステムを使用（v.0.1.8以上のバージョンが必要です）
* 適切なパーティクル同期を修正

releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.6
releases.body: * Adds compatibility with OWO (needs pre-release version of Slate's Shipyard)
releases.bodyZh: * Outer Wilds（OWO）との互換性を追加（スレイトのドックヤードのプレリリースバージョンが必要）

releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.5
releases.bodyZh: * フリーレイクを追加しました

releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.3
releases.body:
* Fixed NRE issue that could happen after a ship got destroyed

Thanks MegaPiggy!

releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.2
releases.body:
* Changed the proxy colliders to make bumping into stuff fell better
* Added a setting to change the dead zone of the input for controllers
* Added a setting to change the control schema to one that better fit controllers

releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.1
releases.body:
* Added "fire" particles
* Fixed interaction prompt appearing even after sitting

releases.name: Shipinha v0.1.0
releases.body: - Adds a custom ship that works just like the one in the alpha mod Navinha
